about.title: Delano Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Delano's collision reports show a familiar pattern: traffic tightens on corridors like Garces Highway, High Street, County Line Road, and Cecil Avenue, with Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. showing the most reported crashes. In a recent year, Kern County recorded 139 injury collisions and 196 injured people in Delano alone, along with 2 traffic deaths. Behind every number is someone dealing with medical bills, missed work, and an insurance adjuster who may call before you've even seen a doctor. LawProactive is not a law firm — we're a free service that connects you with an independent personal injury attorney working on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. Acting early matters: evidence like skid marks, dashcam footage, and witness memories fade fast, and California's filing deadlines don't wait. We can help you find someone to guide you through it.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before Speaking to the Insurance Company

items.title: California's Deadline Is Firm
items.desc: You generally have two years to file a car accident claim in California, but that window shrinks dramatically — sometimes to six months — if a government entity is involved, like a road defect on a city street. An attorney can spot that issue before it costs you your claim.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work Against You
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you're partly at fault, but the percentage assigned to you directly reduces your payout. What you say to an insurance adjuster in a recorded statement can be used to shift more blame onto you.

items.title: No Cap on Pain and Suffering Damages
items.desc: California doesn't limit non-economic damages like pain and suffering in car accident cases, but insurers rarely offer their full value upfront. An independent attorney can push back on lowball offers with proper documentation.

items.question: I was in a crash near the Cecil Avenue and Garces Highway area — what should I do first?
items.answer: Get medical attention even if you feel fine, since some injuries surface days later. Photograph the scene, gather witness contact information if possible, and avoid giving a recorded statement to any insurance company until you've spoken with an attorney. LawProactive can connect you with someone who handles these details for you.

items.question: How much does it cost to work with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing upfront. Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. LawProactive itself is a free connection service and never charges you a fee.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after a Delano car accident?
items.answer: California generally gives you two years from the date of the accident to file a lawsuit, but that period can be much shorter — sometimes six months — if your claim involves a government road or vehicle. Because deadlines vary by circumstance, it's worth getting an attorney's input early rather than waiting.
